barrierLibrary.name: Remote operation
barrierLibrary.description: Operate the surface system remotely so no one is stationed at the equipment.

barrierLibrary.name: Substitute a lower-hazard alternative
barrierLibrary.description: Replace the substance or method with one of lower hazard for the same task.

barrierLibrary.name: Physical guarding
barrierLibrary.description: Fixed guarding or barriers preventing access to the hazard during operation.

barrierLibrary.name: Mechanical interlock
barrierLibrary.description: Interlock that stops the operation when the guard or hatch is opened.

barrierLibrary.name: Continuous gas detection
barrierLibrary.description: Continuous gas detection with alarm set below the exposure limit.

barrierLibrary.name: Walk the line before start-up
barrierLibrary.description: Walk the line and confirm valve line-up before start-up.

barrierLibrary.name: Toolbox talk
barrierLibrary.description: Toolbox talk covering this operation and its controls before work starts.

barrierLibrary.name: Permit to work
barrierLibrary.description: Work carried out under a permit to work with the stated precautions in force.

barrierLibrary.name: Verified competence
barrierLibrary.description: Work performed only by personnel whose competence for the task is documented.

barrierLibrary.name: Hearing protection
barrierLibrary.description: Hearing protection selected for the measured noise dose over the shift.

barrierLibrary.name: Respiratory protection
barrierLibrary.description: Respiratory protection appropriate to the substance and its concentration.
